fields.name: IActivator<TModel>
fields.contract: IActivator<TModel> is a static activation contract for a TModel grain model. An implementing model type provides `Activatate<Tmodel>(string grainType, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> key)`, which receives the grain type and binary key and returns the activated TModel instance.
